problem: Provider-neutral role packets have no executable adapter or tamper-evident request/response receipt.
background: Phase2 orchestration deliberately avoids provider invocation; trust and recursive evidence increments are complete and must remain stable.
alternatives: Add a strict local fake adapter and receipt boundary
decision: Add a canonical bounded request/receipt interface with only a deterministic local fake provider; defer real clients and credentials.
impact: Teams can validate dispatch receipt mechanics and register receipts as ordinary evidence without ledger/schema migration or provider claims.
risk: Fake execution does not establish provider compatibility, model identity, network reliability or organizational authorization; external receipt paths remain local operator custody.
validation: Real CLI request/receipt/tamper/overwrite/path/unknown-provider tests, no-ledger-mutation failure checks, full regression and scaffold.
